profile.roleTitleLong: Senior Hydraulic and Water Resources Engineer
profile.quote: Deep hydraulic engineering paired with _modern computational practice_ — a combination rarely found at this seniority.
profile.bio:
I am a **Senior Hydraulic and Water Resources Engineer** with {{years}} years of experience delivering water engineering projects in Iran and Oman, alongside remote international work — including US-regulated dam safety assessment. Currently serving as **Team Leader** on one of Oman's largest ongoing flood protection programmes — the Batinah Flood Protection Master Plan for the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries & Water Resources, covering the North and South Al Batinah Governorates (15,000 km²) and encompassing several dams, governorate-wide flood protection channels, and stormwater systems.

I specialise in flood modelling and protection, climate adaptation, dam and spillway design, stormwater and sewage master planning, irrigation, water supply, and transient analysis — with a project record spanning national-scale flood risk programmes, US-regulated dam safety assessment, and multi-province flood hazard mapping.

What distinguishes my practice: automation of engineering workflows, geospatial data pipelines, and AI-augmented project delivery alongside deep field expertise.
